entries.title: Lamentations 3:1
segments: I the man have seen affliction by the rod of His wrath.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:2
segments: He has led me and made [me] go in darkness and not into light.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:3
segments: Surely He turned [against me]; He turns His hand all the day.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:4
segments: He has wasted my flesh and my skin; He has broken my bones.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:5
segments: He built against me and has circled [me] with bitterness and hardship.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:6
segments: He has made me live in dark places, like the dead of old.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:7
segments: He has set a fence around me and I cannot go out; He has made my bronze [chain] heavy.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:8
segments: Also when I cry and shout, He shuts out my prayer.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:9
segments: He walled up my ways with cut stone; my paths are crooked.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:10
segments: He [was] a bear lying in wait for me, a lion in secret places.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:11
segments: He has turned my ways aside and torn me in pieces. He made me desolate.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:12
segments: He has bent His bow and set me as a mark for the arrow.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:13
segments: He has caused the arrows of His quiver to enter into my inward parts.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:14
segments: I was a mockery to all my people, their song all the day.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:15
segments: He has filled me with bitterness [and] made me drunk [with] wormwood.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:16
segments: He also broke my teeth with gravel; He has covered me in the ashes.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:17
segments: And You cast off my soul from peace; I have forgotten blessedness.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:18
segments: And I said, My strength and my hope from the LORD [are] gone.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:19
segments: Remember my affliction and my wandering, [as] wormwood and bitterness.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:20
segments: My soul vividly remembers and bows down on me.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:21
segments: I recall this to my mind; therefore I hope.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:22
segments: [It is] by the LORD's kindnesses that we are not destroyed, because His mercies never fail.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:23
segments: [They are] new every morning; great [is] Your faithfulness.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:24
segments: The LORD [is] my portion, says my soul; therefore I will hope in Him.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:25
segments: The LORD [is] good to those who wait for Him, to the soul who seeks Him.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:26
segments: [It is] good that one should hope for the salvation of the LORD, even in silence.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:27
segments: [It is] good for a man that he bear the yoke in his youth.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:28
segments: He sits alone and keeps silence because He laid [it] on him.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:29
segments: He puts his mouth in the dust, if perhaps there may be hope.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:30
segments: He gives [his] cheek to Him who strikes him; he is filled with reproach.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:31
segments: For the Lord will not cast off forever;

entries.title: Lamentations 3:32
segments: for though He causes grief, yet He will have pity according to the multitude of His kindnesses.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:33
segments: For He does not afflict from His heart, nor does He grieve the sons of men;

entries.title: Lamentations 3:34
segments: to crush all the prisoners of the earth under his feet;

entries.title: Lamentations 3:35
segments: to turn aside the right of a man before the face of the Most High;

entries.title: Lamentations 3:36
segments: to pervert a man in his cause-- [this] the LORD does not see.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:37
segments: Who [is] this [who] speaks, and it occurs, [when] the Lord does not command it?

entries.title: Lamentations 3:38
segments: From the mouth of the Most High does not go out the evil and the good.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:39
segments: What? Should mankind complain, a living man, because of his sins?

entries.title: Lamentations 3:40
segments: Let us search and try our ways, and turn again to the LORD.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:41
segments: Let us lift up our heart [and] hands to God in Heaven.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:42
segments: We have sinned and have rebelled; You have not forgiven.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:43
segments: You have wrapped Yourself with anger and pursued us; You have slain; You have not pitied.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:44
segments: You have wrapped Yourself with a cloud from [any] prayer passing through.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:45
segments: You have made us [as] the sweepings and garbage in the midst of the peoples.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:46
segments: All our enemies have opened their mouths against us.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:47
segments: Fear and a pit have come to us, shame and ruin.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:48
segments: Streams of water run down my eye for the ruin of the daughter of my people.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:49
segments: My eye flows out and does not cease, from there being no intermission,

entries.title: Lamentations 3:50
segments: until the LORD shall look down and behold from Heaven.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:51
segments: My eye pains my soul because of all the daughters of my city.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:52
segments: My haters have hunted me, like a bird, without cause.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:53
segments: They have cut off my life in the pit, and cast a stone at me.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:54
segments: Waters flowed over my head; [then] I said, I am cut off.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:55
segments: I called on Your name, O LORD, out of the lowest pit.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:56
segments: You have heard my voice; do not hide Your ear at my relief, at my cry for help.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:57
segments: You drew near in the day [that] I called on You; You said, Fear not.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:58
segments: O LORD, You strove for the causes of my soul; You redeemed my life.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:59
segments: O Lord, You have seen my wrong; judge my cause.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:60
segments: You have seen all their vengeance, all their plots against me.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:61
segments: You have heard their reproach, O LORD, all their plots against me;

entries.title: Lamentations 3:62
segments: the lips of those who rose up against me, and their scheming against me all the day.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:63
segments: Behold their sitting down and their rising up; I [am] their song.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:64
segments: You will return to them a recompense, O LORD, according to the work of their hands.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:65
segments: You will give them dullness of heart, Your curse on them.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:66
segments: Pursue and destroy them in anger from under the heavens of the LORD.
